T: Fish or the steak? We had the lasagne.
D: A former pilot with a drinking problem has to land a plane when the crew gets food poisoning.
P: Serve the mains right after the fish course takes out the crew.
S: Dry-roasted peanuts and almonds in small packets, a pinch of sugar and salt, warmed in the oven for 5 minutes.
for the crew who skipped the fish
Cheddar cut into cubes, crackers, green grapes and cocktail onions threaded on toothpicks, laid out in neat rows on a tray like an old airline service.
he has a drinking problem, it ends up everywhere but his mouth

Twice-baked almond and orange biscotti, crisp enough to dunk, served with small cups of espresso topped with a spoon of whipped cream. Whisk 2 eggs with 150g caster sugar, then mix in 250g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, the zest of 1 orange and 100g whole almonds. Shape into 2 logs on a lined tray and bake at 175C for 25 minutes. Cool 10 minutes, slice 1cm thick on an angle and bake again at 150C for 10 minutes a side. Brew 4 espressos and top each with a spoon of whipped cream.
M: Sirloin seared hard, rested, peppercorn sauce, mashed potato and green beans, served on an airline-style tray.
for anyone who didn't choose the fish

Slow-simmered beef and pork ragù layered with pasta sheets, nutmeg béchamel and mozzarella, baked until bubbling and golden at the edges. Brown 500g beef mince and 250g pork mince, add 1 diced onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stick and 2 garlic cloves, then 125ml red wine, 700ml passata and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Simmer 2 hours. Melt 60g butter, stir in 60g flour, whisk in 700ml milk and cook until thick, adding nutmeg and 50g parmesan. Layer ragù, fresh lasagne sheets and béchamel three times in a dish, top with 200g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 45 minutes. Rest 20 minutes before cutting.
W: on the flight to Chicago, in a little square
Baked New York cheesecake in a slab tin, cut into neat squares, a cherry on each.
K: the coffee pot that keeps coming down the aisle

Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup until foamy, strained into chilled coupes with three coffee beans. Brew 4 shots of espresso and cool for 5 minutes. Add the espresso, 160ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 20ml sugar syrup to a shaker full of ice. Shake very hard for 15 seconds to build the foam. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and float 3 coffee beans on each.

edition.tagline: Fish or the steak? We had the lasagne.
edition.cue: Serve the mains right after the fish course takes out the crew.

s.note: Neat rows of cheese, crackers, grapes and cocktail onions
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into cubes. Thread cubes onto toothpicks with a green grape and a cocktail onion. Lay them out in neat rows on a tray beside a row of crackers, like an old airline snack service.

s.note: Warm salted nuts in little packets
s.how: Mix 200g dry-roasted peanuts and 100g almonds with a pinch of sugar and salt. Warm on a tray at 160C for 5 minutes. Cool slightly and divide into small paper packets, one for each passenger.

m.note: Peppercorn sirloin with mash and beans on a tray
m.how: Sear 4 sirloins hard and rest. Crush 1 tbsp peppercorns into the pan, add 250ml cream and reduce until thick. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and milk. Steam 300g green beans. Serve on trays, airline style.

w.note: Baked cheesecake slab in neat squares with a cherry
w.how: Mix 250g crushed biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a slab tin. Beat 750g cream cheese, 200g sugar, 3 eggs and 150g sour cream. Bake in a water bath at 150C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight, cut into squares and top each with a cherry.

d.note: Fresh espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup until foamy, strained into chilled coupes with three coffee beans.
d.how: Brew 4 shots of espresso and cool for 5 minutes. Add the espresso, 160ml vodka, 80ml coffee liqueur and 20ml sugar syrup to a shaker full of ice. Shake very hard for 15 seconds to build the foam. Strain into 4 chilled coupes and float 3 coffee beans on each.
